review.note: The 2006 ruling says Conjurer's Ban only affects cards, but the current Oracle text reads 'spells with the chosen name can't be cast'; a copy cast with Eye of the Storm is a spell with that name (707.10, 707.12), so under current wording it is stopped. Stale ruling that contradicts the shown Oracle text.

question: Conjurer's Ban only affects cards. Does it stop a copy of a card, such as one created by Eye of the Storm, from being played?

expected.shortAnswer: No: a copy of a card isn't a card, so it can be played.
expected.answer: Conjurer's Ban only affects cards. A copy of a card (for example, one created by Eye of the Storm isn't a card, so it can be played.
